name: mlh1_positive_control_per_patient
supersedes_design: docs/prereg_g2_mlh1.md's difference-in-differences, which needed mlh1_intact_mmrd as a mechanistic negative control. That arm is n=4 here and n=4 on the original GSE178341 path after depth matching -- two independent pipelines, so it is a property of the cohort. The DiD is not available on this data.
why_not_the_usual_interval: the percentile bootstrap over patients, used everywhere else in this repository, has a false-positive rate of 9.6% at n=10 against a nominal 5% -- z*sqrt((n-1)/n)/t(n-1), a function of n alone. Measured and committed BEFORE this ran: results/*/interval_calibration.parquet.

arms.mlh1_unmethylated: secondary, CONFOUNDED: mostly MMR-proficient patients, so it mixes methylation status with MSI status. Not the mechanistic control the original prereg wanted.
arms.mlh1_intact_mmrd: pre-registered control, UNDERPOWERED. At n=4 the percentile interval fires 19% of the time under a true null. No verdict is taken from it.

premise_in_primary_arm.detail: UNRESOLVED: control ACTB +0.443 [+0.116, +0.737] on log2 expression (tolerance 0.5). The interval straddles the tolerance, so whether this control moved is not settled at this many patients. Not refused and not satisfied -- undecided, and reported as such.

premise_caveat: premise_holds is an EQUIVALENCE test on the percentile bootstrap. A narrower interval fits inside the tolerance more easily, so at n=10 that check errs toward HOLDS. Anti-conservative here.

instrument_verdict.detail: the premise does not hold in the methylated arm (UNRESOLVED: control ACTB +0.443 [+0.116, +0.737] on log2 expression (tolerance 0.5). The interval straddles the tolerance, so whether this control moved is not settled at this many patients. Not refused and not satisfied -- undecided, and reported as such.). The cells compared are not established to be the same population, so MLH1 moving or not moving inside them says nothing about silencing. This is not a negative result.

unlabellable.reason: no reference cell survives depth matching; the cut points would come from nothing. Lower depth_quantile.

what_this_cannot_say: that the response is SPECIFIC to promoter methylation. That needs the mechanistic negative control, which this cohort does not have at usable size.
